question: Buddha Purnima, celebrated by the devotees of Gautam Buddha, is celebrated in the Hindu month of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vaisakha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** Buddha Purnima is a festival celebrated by the followers of Gautam Buddha, which marks the birth anniversary of Buddha.**

 
 
• The festival is celebrated in the Hindu month of Vaisakha, which falls between April and May in the Gregorian calendar
